messages:
Mira: Heads-up: hit a duplicate side-effect in staging. starter-sample sent the same generate request twice after a token refresh and our backend applied it twice.
Sam: damn. can you share a tiny trace?
Mira: sure. flow: call /v1/generate -> short-lived token expires -> refresh flow returns new token -> client retries original request (stream/text) -> backend saw same payload twice. logs: `req#842: 401 -> refresh -> retry -> 200` then `req#843: 200` for same op.
Jon: is the sample app using any idempotency header at all?
Sam: not for streaming endpoints. our SDK adds `Idempotency-Key` for non-stream create endpoints but the sample app uses the streaming API with no guard.
Mira: proposal: two-pronged defense: client-side short LRU replay cache + server-side lightweight replay window keyed by `Idempotency-Key` or `X-RW-Replay-Token`. client includes UUID per logical operation.
Sam: LRU cache makes sense to avoid double-sends when auth rotates mid-flight. what's the server TTL?
Jon: thinking default 8s, tunable per-account. implementation could be a fixed-size TTL cache with bloom-filter fallback for high-throughput routes. keep it mem-only to avoid long-term state.
Mira: agree. also add randomized backoff jitter to avoid synchronized retries. current starter uses deterministic doubling (200ms, 400ms, etc). switch to exponential with jitter factor: `sleep = base * 2^n * (1 + rand()*0.5)`.
Sam: good. we should also document when to rely on server-side dedupe vs client-side commit semantics. for streaming, server may not be able to natively dedupe partial streams.
Mira: UX for devs: starter-kit will add `replay-safe-mode: client` or `replay-safe-mode: server` flag in config. default `server` for hosted users; `client` for sample apps to be safe locally.
Jon: naming nit: prefer standard `Idempotency-Key` header for parity with other infra; custom `X-RW-Replay-Token` can be optional for telemetry.
Mira: fine. change plan: include `Idempotency-Key: uuidv4()` + optional `X-RW-Replay-TTL: 8`. update README with example: 
``` 
// starter-kit snippet
const headers = {
  Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  'Idempotency-Key': opUuid, // uuidv4
  'X-RW-Replay-TTL': '8' // seconds, optional
}
```
Sam: add a unit/integration test in starter that simulates token rotation: intercept 401 path, force retry, assert server-side op applied once.
Mira: adding test. will mock server dedupe TTL to be short so CI is fast.
Jon: ops note: dedicated/private tenants might disable server-side replay (compliance). expose warning in logs if you disable it and rely solely on client guards.
deploy-bot: deployment triggered for branch mira/replay-proofing-2026 0/20 CI checks: 3 failed (lint + flaky test + typecheck).
Mira: will fix lint and flaky test. aiming to open PR with starter-kit + docs + tests today. tagging @Sam for header parity review.
Sam: ack. quick follow-up: add telemetry events when a dedupe suppression happens (so we can tune TTL).
Mira: good idea, will emit `replay.suppressed` with sampling. PR in ~3h. thanks :+1:
